name: Mac Trackpad
author: 2strange
description: Mac-like settings for the built-in trackpad, in the bar: natural scrolling, tracking and scroll speed, tap to click, two-finger right click, ignore while typing, applied live through Hyprland. No daemon: the menu writes one Hyprland file. Plus its own three-finger workspace swipe that follows your fingers, keeps empty workspaces, works from workspace 1 and at the last workspace stops, opens a new one or wraps around. The MagicMouse plugin uses this same swipe and its settings when the mouse acts as a trackpad.

barWidget.description: Click for trackpad settings; every control applies live through hypr/trackpad.lua
